items.detail_en: In the principal's office with Principal Lin Mao-hsing. The topic: his philosophy of education, and why the school promotes international connections and English education.
items.detail_zh: 在校長室，採訪林茂興校長。題目：校長的教育理念，以及為何要推廣國際連結與英語教育。
items.note_en: For the Voices in Education series.
items.note_zh: 收錄於「教育之聲」校長專訪系列。

items.note_en: Same students as the class before — a different deck.
items.note_zh: 與上一節同一批學生、不同套簡報。

footnote_en: Two 40-minute classes with a 10-minute break between them.
footnote_zh: 兩節課各 40 分鐘，中間休息 10 分鐘。
